integrity.mathematical_basis: Exact stagewise solution and strict ordering comparisons; reproducible Python 3 checker for finite examples. Continuous parameter claim proved analytically, not inferred from sampling.
integrity.source_date_basis: Vaze and Chiew publisher page explicitly states first published 19 June 2003.

scientific_limitations: Single linear well-mixed pollutant stock with positive constant concurrent input, equal-duration three-stage rate permutations, no flushing in receiving pool and a time-integrated accumulated-mass proxy. Not an empirical stormwater, routed watershed, concentration, or clinical exposure forecast. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Sharp three-stage stormwater exposure ordering with continued pollutant supply
